$comment: OMN-18335. The command vocabulary of a body-REPLACING pull-request edit,
and the one pattern that recognises a change-control evidence-source line.
Read by plugins/onex/hooks/lib/pr_body_stamp_guard.py, which is invoked by
the pre_tool_use_pr_body_stamp_guard.sh PreToolUse hook. The vocabulary
lives here, not in the checker, so adding a shape is a config edit visible
in one place rather than a rule a reader has to infer from a Python
literal. Same argument, same file format and same directory as
credential_rotation_policy.json and ticket_creation_policy.json.
JSON rather than YAML deliberately: the checker sits on a fail-closed
enforcement path and parses its own policy with the standard library
alone. A missing PyYAML in the resolved interpreter would otherwise turn
into a refusal of Bash traffic on the machine.
There is deliberately NO escape entry -- no wildcard shape, no exempt
marker, no allow_all. Destroying the evidence line is the defect this
guard refuses, and a sanctioned spelling for it is a sanctioned incident.
The remedy is the paste the refusal prints.
stamp_line_pattern / stamp_line_flags -- ONE vocabulary, not a second
spelling. Byte-for-byte the pattern and flags of EVIDENCE_SOURCE_RE in
scripts/ci/check_occ_companion_merged.py, the omniclaude-side authority
the OCC companion gate already reads a product pull-request body with,
and itself the shape onex_change_control's preflight and receipt-gate
callers grep for. tests/hooks/test_pr_body_stamp_guard.py pins the
equality: changing one without the other turns the suite red.
gh_pr_edit / gh_api_patch -- each is matched against the TOKENS of one
shell segment, never against the raw text. Token matching by program is
what keeps `echo 'gh pr edit 42 --body ...'` out of the gate: the
program of that segment is echo, so no shape applies. Raw-substring
matching would fire on prose that merely mentions the command --
the workspace CLAUDE.md rule 15, a gate firing on documentation about the
gate.
Both shapes name only the flags that REPLACE a body. --add-label,
--title, --milestone, --json, a bare `gh api` read and `gh pr comment`
are outside every shape and are never gated. Reads are not allowlisted;
they simply match nothing.
gh_api_patch exists because `gh pr edit` refuses a MERGED pull request,
so the REST PATCH is the shape a lane actually uses on the surface where
the plan of record measured two of its four losses.
